original_sentence: "Unite is concerned that without safeguards, any benefits will bypass workers in low-paying jobs, such as waiters," says the union's London regional officer, Dave Turnbull.
translation: 工会伦敦区域官员 Dave Turnbull 说：“Unite 工会担心，如果没有保障措施，任何收益都会绕过服务员等低薪岗位的劳动者。”

key_vocabulary.usage_note: be concerned that 在本句中对应"担心……"。
without safeguards 在本句中对应"没有保障措施"。
bypass workers 在本句中对应"绕过劳动者"。
low-paying jobs 在本句中对应"低薪岗位"。
